reasoning.step1:
1) Classify document as invoice:
- Contains explicit headings "RECHNUNG", "Rechnungsnummer", "Nettowert", "MwSt.", "Endbetrag", payment terms, bank details. No exclusion terms like "Mahnung" or "Zahlungserinnerung". Conclusion: document is an invoice.

2) Locate invoice date:
- Found "Datum 15.11.2023" in delivery/line section. Extract Invoice.Date = "15.11.2023".

3) Locate Grand Total:
- "Endbetrag 562,65" with currency EUR. Extract GrandTotal.Amount = 562.65 (preserve two decimals; convert comma to dot for numeric).

4) Locate sender VAT ID:
- Bottom shows "UID ATU72890767" and earlier "Unsere Steuernummer ATU72890767". Sender is Marcher Feinkost GmbH; extract Sender.VatId = "ATU72890767".

5) Locate VAT group(s), net and VAT amounts:
- Line "Nettowert 511,50" and "MwSt. 10,00 % von 511,50 51,15". This indicates a single VAT group at 10% with net 511,50 and VAT amount 51,15. Extract Vat.Rate = 10, Net.Amount = 511.50, Vat.Amount = 51.15 (preserve decimals, convert commas to dots; Vat.Rate as number without %).

6) Verify consistency:
- Net 511.50 + VAT 51.15 = 562.65 matches Endbetrag. No other VAT rates or exchange rates present. No missing required fields.

7) Note on non-inference:
- All extracted values come directly from the text; no guessing performed.
